entry.title: Why Most Resumes Fail ATS (What I Learned While Building One)
entry.summary: I used to think resumes fail because people aren’t skilled enough. That’s wrong. Most resumes fail because they never reach a human. While building an AI-powered resume ATS tool, I spent time understanding how Applicant Tracking Systems actually work. What I found was frustrating, especially for genuinely good candidates. ATS systems don’t “understand” design. They extract text, match patterns, and score relevance. That’s it. If your resume relies on: Tables Icons Fancy columns Visual timelines there’s a good chance important information never gets parsed correctly.
